purpose: The holdout's exclusion list (PREREGISTRATION.md, H1 to H3). It is built from the development data of 1 November 2026 and holds none of their engine results.

rules.H1: A work is ineligible if an entry below records it (its volume, issue or edition) as read, or as the source of a verified candidate. Sources an entry names but records as not read are eligible, unless a verified candidate came from the same volume or issue.
rules.H2: Another edition or printing of an ineligible work is ineligible for any example that work contains.
rules.H3: A development return (same native, same body, same return year) is ineligible from any source.
